QuestInfo.name: The Explorers' Invitation
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# needs your help preparing for the continental conference.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver #p1101000#'s letter to #p1012100# at the Bowman Instruction School. Since Ereve has some history with #p1012100#, #p1101002# hopes that she will be open to the idea of a continental conference.

0.0: A continental conference isn't much good if we're the only ones who attend. We have to invite the leaders of other groups, like the Explorers and the Resistance.
0.1: The Explorers aren't really an organization, so there's no one leader, but #p1012100# of the Bowman Instruction School in #m100000000# is well respected among them.
0.2: More importantly, she's lived through the Black Mage's tyranny. She'll understand the necessity of our conference.
0.3: Deliver this letter from Empress #p1101000# to #p1012100#.
0.4: You do know who #p1012100# is, right? She is the Elf at the #m100000201# in #m100000000#. \r\n\r\n(You will be moved to #m100000201# after you accept.)

no.0: You'd rather have Maple World fall into the hands of the Black Mage, then?

1.0: I'm afraid I don't offer training to Cygnus Knights. Oh, you have a letter for me? Let me see.
1.1: So, Empress #p1101000# has decided to bring the fight to the Black Mage... We Explorers can't sit idly by, either. The Black Mage is a threat to our freedom.
1.2: I don't represent all Explorers, but I accept your invitation. I will see you at the continental conference.\r\n\r\n(You will be Ereve after you accept.)

npc.0: If you don't intend to deliver the letter to #m100000000#, you may as well give it back to me.

item.0: Welcome to the #m100000201#. Are you interested in becoming a Bowman?
